concurrency_and_state: Zone.players, notBosses, humanoids, bosses, pets, nonInteractiveNPCs use CopyOnWriteArrayList, while Zone.mobs, items, trapMaps, maBuHolds use ArrayList.
Zone.mobs is synchronized in Zone.getTotalHP() and Zone.mapInfo(), but iterated without synchronization in Zone.udMob(), Zone.sendBigBoss(), and Mob.lvMob().
Zone.items is synchronized in udItem(), addItem(), removeItemMap(), pickItem(), getSatellites(), getItemMapByItemMapId(), getItemMapByTempId(), getItemMapsForPlayer().
Mob.temporaryEnemies uses CopyOnWriteArrayList; Mob.injured() and MobMe.injured() are synchronized.
MapDataManager caches use ConcurrentHashMap, but MapDataManager.gI() and Boss10.gI() singletons lack synchronization.
MabuEgg.openEgg() uses an unsynchronized boolean isOpening and schedules a 4000ms task on GameLoopManager; if the scheduled task aborts early, isOpening stays true.
cross_module_questions: How does ItemMapService.removeItemMapAndSendClient interact with Zone.items lock when called from Zone.udItem() -> ItemMap.update()?
Where is Zone.maBuHolds populated? Zone constructor initializes it as an empty ArrayList, and setMaBuHold checks slot < z128.maBuHolds.size().
Does Client opcode -9 (mob HP update) expect delta HP or a flag when Mob.hoi_hp writes 1L for positive heal?
Why are GaChinCua, GauTuongCuop, NguaChinLmao, Piano, and VoiChinNga completely commented out while Map.initMob still references ConstMob.HIRUDEGARN, VUA_BACH_TUOC, ROBOT_BAO_VE, MAY_DO_SUC_MANH?

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Calls PlayerDAO.updatePlayerAsync(plReward) directly from Mob.getItemMobReward when daily mob ruby is awarded; no direct JDBC/Redis in this batch.

findings.impact: Dead mobs spam -124 network messages to all players in the zone on every game tick until they respawn.
findings.root_cause: Operator precedence bug in `if (isBlindDCTT && (Util.canDoWithTime(lastTimeBlindDCTT, timeBlindDCTT)) || mob.isDie())` causes `mob.isDie()` alone to trigger `removeBlindDCTT()` every update tick even when `isBlindDCTT` is false.
findings.title: Dead mobs broadcast removeBlindDCTT (-124) every update tick

findings.impact: Players can gain free gold if unupgradeMagicTree() is triggered while not upgrading or via concurrent menu confirm packets.
findings.root_cause: `unupgradeMagicTree()` and `fastUpgradeMagicTree()` do not check `if (!this.isUpgrade) return;`, and upgrade/unupgrade methods lack synchronization.
findings.title: Missing state guard and synchronization in MagicTree upgrade/cancel

findings.impact: Risk of ConcurrentModificationException or IndexOutOfBoundsException during zone mob updates or boss checks.
findings.root_cause: `Zone.mobs` is a non-thread-safe `ArrayList` that is synchronized in `getTotalHP()` and `mapInfo()` but accessed without synchronization in `udMob()`, `sendBigBoss()`, and `Mob.lvMob()`.
findings.title: Unsynchronized concurrent access to Zone.mobs ArrayList

findings.impact: Potential ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException and wrong pixel Y coordinates returned to callers.
findings.root_cause: `Map.moveXY()` accesses `tileMap[ysd][xsd]` and `tileMap[ysd - p][xsd]` without bounds checks, and returns `ysd` (tile index) instead of `ysd * 24` (pixel coordinate) at lines 414 and 425.
findings.title: Out-of-bounds risk and tile-vs-pixel Y unit mismatch in Map.moveXY

findings.impact: Pet-owned items (passed as `-player.id`) lose negative sign on construction; `pickItem` also truncates `itemMap.playerId` to `int`.
findings.root_cause: `ItemMap` constructor normalizes `this.playerId = playerId != -1 ? Math.abs(playerId) : playerId;`, while `Zone.pickItem` checks `itemMap.playerId == -player.id` and casts `itemMap.playerId` to `int`.
findings.title: ItemMap constructor strips negative pet-owner sign and Zone.pickItem truncates long playerId

findings.impact: If a player disconnects or an error occurs before the 4s timer finishes, `isOpening` remains true and the egg cannot be opened again.
findings.root_cause: `openEgg()` sets `isOpening = true` and only clears `p.mabuEgg = null` inside the 4000ms scheduled callback without resetting `isOpening = false` in a `finally` block or offline branch.
findings.title: MabuEgg.isOpening flag can get stuck true on disconnect or async exception

findings.impact: Subsequent drop checks (Thuc An, Luong Long, Kaio, Manh Thien Su) receive the master Player instead of the pet, altering pet-vs-master checks.
findings.root_cause: `getItemMobReward` reassigns its `player` parameter to `((Pet) player).master` inside the Cold map God-item drop block.
findings.title: Parameter reassignment side-effect in Mob.getItemMobReward

findings.impact: Integer overflow if time elapsed exceeds ~24.8 days, corrupting `lastTimeHarvest`.
findings.root_cause: `(numPeaRelease * getSecondPerPea()) * 1000` multiplies `int * short * int` as 32-bit `int` before adding to `long lastTimeHarvest`.
findings.title: 32-bit int overflow in MagicTree.update harvest timestamp calculation

findings.impact: Creates unnecessary stream/lambda garbage every second per active satellite and scans Zone.players twice.
findings.title: Repeated Stream allocations in Satellite.update loop

findings.impact: Potential buffer/resource leak if `sendMessage` or `sendMessAllPlayerInMap` throws an exception before `msg.cleanup()`.
findings.root_cause: `msg.cleanup()` is placed inside `try` instead of `finally` in `MobMe`, `BaseMenu`, `MabuEgg`, `MagicTree`, `MobEffectSkill`, `Mob.sendMobMaxHp`, and `Zone`.
findings.title: Missing finally blocks for Message.cleanup() across map/mob/npc classes

key_classes.name: MapDataManager
key_classes.responsibility: In-memory ConcurrentHashMap cache for binary map files (bg items, tile maps, effect maps).

key_classes.name: TileMapDataLoader
key_classes.responsibility: Loads tile_set_info and initializes all Map instances from MapTemplate.

key_classes.name: Map
key_classes.responsibility: Represents a game map with tile collision data, waypoints, NPCs, zones, and initial mobs/items/traps.

key_classes.name: Zone
key_classes.responsibility: Manages a single map channel/zone including players, bosses, pets, mobs, ground items, and network broadcasts.

key_classes.name: ItemMap
key_classes.responsibility: Represents a dropped item or satellite on the map with ownership, expiration, and special Black Ball movement logic.

key_classes.name: Mob
key_classes.responsibility: Core monster entity handling combat damage, AI targeting, respawning, task drops, and loot generation.

key_classes.name: Hirudegarn
key_classes.responsibility: Multi-form BigBoss mob with 1% maxHP damage cap, 20M HP drop threshold, and AOE/tail-whip attacks.

key_classes.name: MobEffectSkill
key_classes.responsibility: Tracks and expires crowd-control status effects (stun, sleep, blind, bind, chocolate, Mafuba) on a Mob.

key_classes.name: MobMe
key_classes.responsibility: Namekian summon mob entity that attacks players/mobs and shares damage/shield-break rules.

key_classes.name: MagicTree
key_classes.responsibility: Manages player's Magic Tree (Dau Than) pea generation, harvesting, and timed/instant upgrades.

key_classes.name: MabuEgg
key_classes.responsibility: Manages player's Mabu Egg hatching timer and delayed pet creation/replacement.

module_summary: Deep-read of 33 files (5963 lines) covering map data loading/caching (MapDataManager, TileMapDataLoader), world Map/Zone/ItemMap/Satellite/TrapMap/Boss10 structures, Mob/BigBoss/MobEffectSkill/MobMe/MobPoint combat & loot systems, and MabuEgg/MagicTree NPCs.
